acceptanceCriteria: Every named reference path is read at the pinned commit and recorded with one explicit implemented-equivalent, implemented-different-by-design, reference-only, not-applicable, or migrate-gap decision.

Portable installation, upgrade, migration, rollback, ownership, and fail-closed behavior discovered in the named paths is implemented in Rust or an explicit evidence-backed non-portable boundary is documented; no omission is hidden by a deferred classification.

Shared Runtime installation and repository attachment remain separate; attached repositories inherit only repository-bound protocol, isolated state, and human Outcome behavior, not source installer registries or provider-specific policy values.
Tri-language parity and capability documentation identify counterparts, boundaries, and adopter inheritance; inventory and reference-parity records are synchronized.
Focused regressions, full workspace quality, documentation/conformance gates, and Runtime lifecycle evidence pass.
goal: Close a bounded installation and upgrade parity batch while preserving shared Runtime isolation, explicit repository binding, fail-closed migration and human-visible Outcome rules.
intent: Compare the next installation and upgrade reference files one by one and bring any portable repository-governance capability or documented boundary into the Rust Runtime without copying source implementation or source wire formats.
